d:
After weeks of digging, the miners finally bring their hard-earned gold to the weighing table. From massive cleanouts to milestone weigh-ins, every ounce reveals the rewards of their relentless efforts. Who brings in the biggest haul, and whose gold total sets a new benchmark?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 3, 11, 14 and 15; and Season 6, Episodes 3, 4, 6, 9 and 10, on Discovery Channel India.
